lines: In the course of this life.
The old things lie at the back of the shelf.
Even though they are covered in dust.
Even the wounds that become painful units of life.
Even though there is nowhere to look.
What we go through, what we gain.
So that we don't end up seeing it off.
I want to always be on tiptoe.
I thought of myself as such, yet.
Like a role without a name.
We can't even make a spin‑off.
When singing about a trivial love.
I don't want to become a liar.
Board the express train a stop later.
As if I'm the only one alone.
I am the me who cannot be gentle.
As if I'm left behind alone.
Nevertheless, I want to cherish them.
Even on days full of anxiety.
Even a shitty sense of defeat.
My heartbeat high‑fives this trembling earth.
That summer when I risked everything.
It never fades, it cannot be forgotten.
Even though there is nowhere to look.
We must be adding more wounds.
Shall we believe and move forward?
Precisely because of that, let's love.
Even scars that aren't worth it.
